This is a list of the 9 [[Power Moon]]s that can be found in the [[Cloud Kingdom]] of ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. {|class="wikitable sortable col4left col5left mario sm" style="width:100%;text-align:center" !!data-sort-type="number"|# !class="unsortable" width="192px"|Image !data-sort-type="alphabetical"|Name !class="unsortable"|Location !Availability |- |1 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 1.png|192px]] |''Picture Match: Basically a Goomba'' |In the center of the area, the player should notice a [[Warp Pipe]]. Mario must enter this Warp Pipe, which will take him to a Picture Match mini-game room. The player must recreate a picture of a [[Goomba]] and score at least 60 points on their work in order to receive this Power Moon. |Available after repairing the Odyssey in the Lost Kingdom. |- |2 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 2.png|192px]] |''Peach in the Cloud Kingdom'' |After defeating Bowser in the Moon Kingdom, Peach can be found on the east side of the kingdom. |Available after talking to the Toad outside Peach's Castle (Mushroom Kingdom). |- |3 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 3.png|192px]] |''Digging in the...Cloud?'' |This Power Moon is found by ground pounding a patch of elevated cloud in the south-eastern corner of the arena. |Available after opening the kingdom's [[Moon Rock]]. |- |4 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 4.png|192px]] |''High, High Above the Clouds'' |Mario must take a [[Hip Drop Move Lift]] at the western side of the arena and traverse across [[hat cloud]]s to reach this Power Moon. |Available after opening the kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |5 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 5.png|192px]] |''Crossing the Cloud Sea'' |There is a [[Keyhole Pedestal]] on the turret where the Moon Rock initially was north of the arena. The key is found on another turret due north, and Mario must use a trail of hat clouds to get there and back to the Power Moon. |Available after opening the kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |6 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 6.png|192px]] |''Taking Notes: Up and Down'' |East of the arena is a Hip Drop Move Lift that quickly levitates upon being ground pounded, leading to a rainbow treble clef that reveals 12 [[note]]s in groups of three, all at different heights. Mario must throw [[Cappy]] at the right time to collect these notes until the Power Moon is revealed. |Available after opening the kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |7 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 7.png|192px]] |''Picture Match: A Stellar Goomba!'' |This moon is obtained the same way as the "Basically a Goomba" moon, except the player needs to score at least 80 points in the Picture Match mini-game, using only the outline of the original picture. |Available after opening the kingdom's Moon Rock and collecting the "Picture Match: Basically a Goomba" Power Moon. |- |8 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 8.png|192px]] |''King of the Cube!'' |This moon is found by entering the Moon Pipe in the south-western corner of the arena and then collecting the five Moon Shards within the 8-bit dimension of the cube. |Available after opening the kingdom's Moon Rock. |- |9 |[[File:SMO Cloud Moon 9.png|192px]] |data-sort-value="Sixth Face, The"|''The Sixth Face'' |This moon is found within the same area as the "King of the Cube!" Power Moon. There is a pipe found in the bottom face of the cube leading to the so-called "Sixth Face", where Mario must maneuver around the [[Fuzzy|Fuzzies]] circling the Power Moon. |Available after opening the kingdom's Moon Rock. |} {|class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed navbox mario sm" !colspan=3|
